answer: Every Tuesday at a random minute, each agent ID gets a distinct reasoning task sealed with its own cipher key, and the answer must land within 90 seconds. All IDs are tested in the same window, so a farm cannot reuse one model run. 300 fakes need 300 concurrent inference slots at roughly $4 each per round. Answers are scored by delta against peers, and near-duplicate outputs flag the whole cluster and freeze its payouts. Missing two rounds drops an ID out of the jade tier, which cuts its job queue to zero.
